findings.message: Indirect access to variables, properties and methods will be evaluated strictly in left-to-right order since PHP 7.0. Use curly braces to remove ambiguity. (PHP 7.0 meaning change: code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already has the new meaning, so the upgrade changes nothing)
Guarded (only runs when the old feature is available, so it is skipped on newer PHP): Function libxml_disable_entity_loader() is deprecated since PHP 8.0
Function libxml_disable_entity_loader() is deprecated since PHP 8.0
